FROM base_py:3.8

# Install system dependencies
RUN apt update && apt install -y \
    postgresql-client \
    build-essential \
    git-core \
    libpq-dev \
    libxml2-dev \
    libxslt-dev \
    libgeos-dev \
    libssl-dev \
    libffi-dev \
    postgresql \
    postgresql-contrib \
    redis-server \
    default-jdk \
    && apt clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /project

COPY . .

# Install Python dependencies
RUN pip3 install -r requirement-setuptools.txt && \
    pip3 install -r requirements.txt && \
    pip3 install setuptools==44.1.0 && \
    pip3 install -r dev-requirements.txt && \
    python3 setup.py develop && \
    pip3 install setuptools==44.1.0

# Set up services and databases
RUN service postgresql start && \
    service redis-server start && \
    su - postgres -c "createuser -s ckan_default" && \
    su - postgres -c "createuser -s datastore_default" && \
    su - postgres -c "psql -c \"ALTER USER ckan_default WITH PASSWORD 'pass';\"" && \
    su - postgres -c "psql -c \"ALTER USER datastore_default WITH PASSWORD 'pass';\"" && \
    su - postgres -c "createdb -O ckan_default ckan_test" && \
    su - postgres -c "createdb -O datastore_default datastore_test" && \
    ckan -c test-core.ini db init

CMD service postgresql start && service redis-server start && python3 -m pytest ckan/tests/logic/action/test_create.py -v --ckan-ini=test-core.ini

tensorflow__tensorflow_dbdd98c37bc25249e.dockerfile:
FROM base_py:3.9

# Install system dependencies
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    default-jdk \
    curl \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /project

COPY . .

# Install Python dependencies
RUN pip3 install --upgrade setuptools wheel six "numpy~=1.19.2" protobuf absl-py grpcio

# Install Bazel 5.1.1
RUN cd /tmp && \
    curl -fSsL -O https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/releases/download/5.1.1/bazel-5.1.1-installer-linux-x86_64.sh && \
    chmod +x bazel-5.1.1-installer-linux-x86_64.sh && \
    ./bazel-5.1.1-installer-linux-x86_64.sh && \
    rm bazel-5.1.1-installer-linux-x86_64.sh

# Fix numpy compatibility issue
RUN cd /usr/local/lib/python3.9/site-packages/numpy && \
    ln -sf core _core && \
    touch _core/include/numpy/__multiarray_api.c

RUN bazel build --jobs=4 --local_ram_resources=8192 --local_cpu_resources=8 //tensorflow/python/kernel_tests/summary_ops:summary_ops_test 2>&1 | tail -50

CMD bazel test --jobs=4 --local_ram_resources=8192 --local_cpu_resources=8 //tensorflow/python/kernel_tests/summary_ops:summary_ops_test --test_output=errors

FROM base_py:3.11

# coincurve requires libgmp
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        apt-utils \
        gcc \
        git \
        libc6-dev \
        libc-dev \
        libssl-dev \
        libgmp-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /project

COPY . .

# force repository to be clean so the version string is right
RUN git reset --hard
